== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 6 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Tom Marlin (6 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 2]], [[Virtual Set 5]], [[Virtual Set 13]], [[Virtual Set 15]] and [[Virtual Set 23]], sets dated 2015–2024 on this wiki. The credits on [[Daroe (V)|•Daroe (V)]] and [[Daroe (V) (ALT)|•Daroe (V) (AI)]] are shared with [[Ryan Jellison]]. The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Tom Marlin|Card Credits]].
